'''Bomba Island''' (Japanese: '''バンバ島''' ''Bamba Island'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Hoenn]], which appeared in ''[[AG092|Judgment Day!]]''. It is located between [[Lilycove City]] and [[Mossdeep City]].

It is possible to reach the island by ferry from Lilycove City. In their haste to reach the Mossdeep-bound service, {{Ash}}, {{an|Brock}}, {{an|May}}, and [[Max]] ended up on Bomba Island after taking this ferry by accident. While there, they met {{OBP|Jimmy|AG092}} and his teacher {{OBP|Serena|AG092}}, and learned that referees were trained on the island.

Even though Jimmy was being trained on the island to become a referee, it was not what he originally wanted to do; he ended up on the island by accident while he fell asleep in a boat that drifted away. Later, his {{p|Wartortle}} evolved to a {{p|Blastoise}} during a fight with {{TRT}} who he then defeated, Following Serena's advice, Jimmy decided to stop his referee training and resume his true passions of journeying as a [[Pokémon Trainer]].

==Places of Interest==
[[File:Pokémon Battle Judge Training Institute.png|thumb|200px|right|The Pokémon Battle Judge Training Institute]]
===Pokémon Battle Judge Training Institute===
The '''Pokémon Battle Judge Training Institute''' is a {{pkmn|world}} leading school for [[Battle judge]]s. Professor {{OBP|Serena|AG092}} teaches at the Institute.

At Serena's request, {{Ash}} and {{an|Brock}} competed in a [[Double Battle]] while student {{OBP|Jimmy|AG092}} refereed the match. Jimmy, however, was not confident with his rulings and prematurely declared [[Ash's Corphish]] knocked out, so Serena ordered the match to end.

==Trivia==
* Jimmy mentions that for battle judge training, the Pokémon Battle Judge Training Institute is the "only one there is," either indicating that all judges are trained out of Hoenn, it is the only battle judge school in Hoenn, or it is the top school for such training (if not one of the top schools).

===Name origin===
Its name may come from the Greek word [[wiktionary:βόμβα|βόμβα]], which means bomb.
